# Third-party notices

Most of Paint Commons is dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](LICENSE). Some records come from other open projects and keep their licence: each colour names its source (`colour.source`), as does each paint imported from another project (`source`), and [sources.json](sources.json) gives every source's licence and credit. If you copy records that cite one of the sources below, keep its notice with them.

## GERInFact — TTC–Citadel Converter numeric colour data

Attribution: **GERInFact**, author of the [TTC–Citadel Converter](https://gerinfact.github.io/ttc_citadel/), [repository](https://github.com/GERInFact/ttc_citadel). Numeric paint-name/hex pairs are taken from [`colors.json` at revision 235dc3f5fda248a2499d68098cbc000e232f413a](https://github.com/GERInFact/ttc_citadel/blob/235dc3f5fda248a2499d68098cbc000e232f413a/colors.json).

No explicit upstream licence was found at that revision. Paint Commons publishes these values as facts (source licence `LicenseRef-facts`): a paint’s name and an approximate colour are factual, so they are reused with credit. This is not an MIT or CC0 licence assertion, an upstream permission grant, or a claim that source code, logos, chart artwork or photographs are freely reusable. Any rights that apply to the source data remain unaffected by this repository’s dedication of its own contributions. Retain this attribution, provenance and rights disclosure with redistributed copies of these imported values.

Thirty exact-name Dark Arts matches supply new colours. Existing colours are preserved in the TTC import; alternative values are pending review separately. The derived snapshot retains only TTC names, uppercase hex values and original array indices, excluding Citadel matches, code and images. Its provenance and integrity hashes are in `data/upstream/gerinfact-235dc3f/SOURCE.json`.
